title: Retain the strong ordinary service without reversing its arrow
statement: At exact flat source scope, common-frame RDS programmes implement the flat Petz inverse with paid known-amplitude amplification and O(k^2r^2/epsilon) original calls. The separate established conjugate-channel service costs at mostk(rD-k)/epsilon but maps k->D; it provides no arbitrary-payload D->k inverse or restoring draw by itself. The pure-isometry converter with an independent replacement for the lost environment has Fe=1/k^2+(f_UI-1/k^2)/r^2, an explicit failed transfer rather than a universal decoder no-go.
